$comment: LS ELECTRIC XGT Cnet dedicated-protocol golden vectors. Frame layout, command set, command types, data-area layouts and the error-code table are from 'Cnet I/F Module, XGT Series (XGL-C22A/C22B/CH2A/CH2B/C42A/C42B) User's Manual', LS ELECTRIC, V3.3 2023.05, Ch.7. The BCC rule — present only when the command letter is lowercase; value is the unsigned 8-bit sum of every byte from the header byte through the tail byte, BOTH INCLUSIVE, rendered as two ASCII hex characters — and the worked example in 'manualBcc' are from the 'XGB Cnet I/F User's Manual' V2.0. Only 'manualBcc' has its BCC value printed in a manual; every other entry reproduces a manual example frame BODY verbatim and its 'bcc' is DERIVED by applying that same published arithmetic (marked with $derived). 'nakResponse' is not a manual example at all: it is CONSTRUCTED from the documented NAK layout and the published error table. The manuals carry transcription typos (a '%M000' name whose printed length field says 6, '%TW000' written for '%MW000', and h03 printed for EOT in one table); the corrected forms are used here. DO NOT MODIFY.

control.$note: Control characters, ASCII. Requests are ENQ..EOT; responses are ACK/NAK..ETX.

manualBcc.$note: The one BCC value printed in the manuals. Individual read (RSS), station 20, one block, %MW100. The manual's own arithmetic: H05+H32+H30+H72+H53+H53+H30+H31+H30+H36+H25+H4D+H57+H31+H30+H30+H04 = H03A4, so BCC = 'A4' (ASCII 41 34).

readIndividualRequest.$note: RSS, station 01, two blocks: read %MW020 and %PW001.

readIndividualAck.$note: ACK to the frame above: two blocks, each 2 bytes (one word) of data.

writeIndividualAck.$note: ACK to a write: station, command and command type only — no data area.

writeContinuousRequest.$note: WSB, station 01, write HAA15 to %DW000 (D area, word type — 1 word = 4 data characters).
writeContinuousRequest.name: %DW000

readContinuousRequest.$note: RSB, station 0A, read 2 words from %MW000. No block-count field on a continuous request.
readContinuousRequest.name: %MW000

readContinuousAck.$note: ACK to the frame above, with the block-count field ('01') present: 4 bytes of data.

readContinuousAckNoBlockField.$note: The same response as printed in a manual example that omits the block-count field. Both forms must decode.

monitorRegisterRequest.$note: Monitor register (x), station 01, registration number 01, registering RSS for one block %MW000. The registered command keeps its own letter case; the BCC rule follows the OUTER letter (x).

monitorExecuteRequest.$note: Monitor execute (y), station 01, registration number 01. No data area.

nakResponse.$note: NOT a manual example — CONSTRUCTED from the documented NAK layout (NAK | station | command | type | 4-character error code | ETX | BCC) and error code 0011 from the published table.

errorCodes.$note: Error codes returned in a NAK response, 4 ASCII characters.
errorCodes.0090: monitor execution error (registration number not registered)
errorCodes.0190: monitor execution error (registration number out of range)
errorCodes.0290: monitor registration error (registration number out of range)
errorCodes.1332: data type mismatch (blocks must share one data type)
